chinese_description: 胶体,吸收水分之后颜色会变深,变得不那么粘稠而且导热系数会增加

english_description: Smart particles, Travels in straight lines and avoids obstacles. Grows with time.
chinese_description: 智能微粒,绝对零度的粒子,会智能躲避障碍随时间流逝尾巴会变长,可用于降温

english_description: Titanium. Higher melting temperature than most other metals, blocks all air pressure.
chinese_description: 钛,金属固体坚固的材料熔点很高能导电,会吸收中子

english_description: Exotic matter. Explodes with excess exposure to electrons. Has many other odd reactions.
chinese_description: 奇异物质,在电子的轰击下会发出彩虹色的光并产生压力

english_description: Reserved official element slot; never reuse this numeric ID.
chinese_description: 官方保留元素槽位；不得重新使用此数字 ID。
notes: Tombstone mapped to Meson disabler(); preserves save-ID continuity.

english_description: Sparks. Formed by explosions.
chinese_description: 火花,炸药爆炸产生

english_description: Hydrogen. Combusts with OXYG to make WATR. Undergoes fusion at high temperature and pressure.
chinese_description: 氢气,与氧气燃烧产生水,在高温高压下发生聚变

english_description: Soap. Creates bubbles, washes off deco color, and cures virus.
chinese_description: 肥皂,0.5P时产生肥皂泡可以洗去染色肥皂泡在-25℃/248.15k时会凝固

english_description: Black hole, sucks in particles using gravity. (Requires Newtonian gravity)
chinese_description: 黑洞,使用需开启牛顿万有引力,产生引力吸入物质并升温

english_description: White hole, pushes away other particles with gravity. (Requires Newtonian gravity)
chinese_description: 白洞,使用需开启牛顿万有引力,产生斥力排斥物质

english_description: Mercury. Volume changes with temperature, Conductive.
chinese_description: 水银,体积随温度变化,可以导电

english_description: Powered breakable clone.
chinese_description: 可控可破坏复制体,激活时和可破坏复制体相同

english_description: Gravity pump. Changes gravity to its temp when activated. (use HEAT/COOL)
chinese_description: 引力泵,激活时改变其万有引力为自身温度值

english_description: Clay dust. Produces paste when mixed with water.
chinese_description: 粘土砂,和水结合时产生浆糊(PSTE)

english_description: WireWorld wires, conducts based on a set of GOL-like rules.
chinese_description: WireWorld线,一种基于另一个名为WireWorld游戏的固体导电元素

english_description: Gravity bomb. Sticks to the first object it touches then produces a strong gravity push.
chinese_description: 引力炸弹,黏在接触的第一个物体上,产生强大的引力推力

english_description: Fighter. Tries to kill stickmen. You must first give it an element to kill him with.
chinese_description: 打手,电脑控制的小人,会通过喷东西来杀死火柴人

english_description: Force Emitter. Pushes or pulls objects based on its temperature. Use like ARAY.
chinese_description: F射线发射器,会沿着电流方向寻找物质并施加力(与ARAY的方向判定规则一样)

english_description: Repels or attracts particles based on its temperature.
chinese_description: 反射极,无需通电,和FRAY一样,根据温度来吸引或推开物质

english_description: Powered version of PIPE, use PSCN/NSCN to Activate/Deactivate.
chinese_description: 可控动力管,P型硅激活时运输,用N型硅则会停止运输,用超导线会反方向运输

english_description: Detector, creates a spark when something with its ctype is nearby.
chinese_description: 探测器,有相同的物质与之接触时产生电脉冲

english_description: Generates damaging pressure and breaks any elements it hits.
chinese_description: 重力炸弹,对碰到它的物质表面产生一个破坏性的压力

english_description: Temperature sensor, creates a spark when there's a nearby particle with a greater temperature.
chinese_description: 温度传感器,可以用HEAT/COOL来改变自身温度,当周围有温度比它高的物质时会发出电脉冲

english_description: Vibranium. Stores energy and releases it in violent explosions.
chinese_description: 振金,可以储存能量在猛烈的爆炸中释放出来

english_description: Broken vibranium.
chinese_description: 振金粉,粉末状的振金

english_description: Particle Ray Emitter. Creates a beam of particles set by its ctype, with a range set by tmp.
chinese_description: 物质射线发射器,发射一个由其Ctype设置的粒子束,其范围由Tmp设置

english_description: Piston, pushes particles. PSCN extends, NSCN retracts
chinese_description: 活塞,用PSCN激活时变长

english_description: Frame, can be used with pistons to push many particles.
chinese_description: 支架,用于增加活塞一次性推动物质的数量

english_description: Corrosion resistant metal, will reverse corrosion of iron. Excellent conductor.
chinese_description: 金,抗腐蚀(但通电时会受到酸的腐蚀),可以保护铁免受腐蚀

english_description: Tungsten. Brittle metal with a very high melting point.
chinese_description: 钨,脆性金属具有很高的熔点,但不耐压

english_description: Pressure sensor, creates a spark when the pressure is greater than its temperature.
chinese_description: 压力传感器,压力高于其温度时产生火花。

english_description: Protons. Transfer heat to materials, and remove sparks.
chinese_description: 质子,不能穿透绝缘体,虚空,钻石,振金以及墙会清除碰到电脉冲

english_description: Virus. Turns everything it touches into virus.
chinese_description: 病毒,会将其碰触到的所有物质变成VIRS

english_description: Solid Virus. Turns everything it touches into virus.
chinese_description: 病毒块,会将其碰触到的所有物质变成VIRS

english_description: Gas Virus. Turns everything it touches into virus.
chinese_description: 病毒气,会将其碰触到的所有物质变成VIRS

english_description: Gravitons. Create Newtonian Gravity.
chinese_description: 引力子，会在周围产生额外的牛顿引力场。

english_description: Duplicator ray. Replicates a line of particles in front of it.
chinese_description: D射线发射器,会将沿电流方向对前方的所有粒子

english_description: Ceramic. Gets stronger under pressure.
chinese_description: 陶瓷,受压时熔点增加

english_description: Rapid heat conductor.
chinese_description: 导热体,导热速度比任何其他材料都快

english_description: Sawdust. Floats on water.
chinese_description: 锯末,轻粉末,可以漂浮在水面上

english_description: Polonium, highly radioactive. Decays into NEUT and heats up.
chinese_description: 钋,高放射性,衰变成NEUT并升温

english_description: Refrigerant. Heats up and liquefies under pressure.
chinese_description: 制冷剂,一种淡蓝色气体,在2P或更大压力下液化时加热,反之蒸发时冷却

english_description: Liquid refrigerant.
chinese_description: 液态制冷剂

english_description: Life sensor, creates a spark when there's a nearby particle with a life higher than its temperature.
chinese_description: 生命探测器,当其周围元素Life值高于传感器温度时,产生电流

english_description: Linear detector. Scans in 8 directions for particles with its ctype and creates a spark on the opposite side.
chinese_description: 线性探测器,从8个方向检测粒子,并在相反方向激发导体

english_description: Silicon Powder: Sparkling conductive silicon that forms glassy silica when heated in oxygen.
chinese_description: 硅粉：闪亮且导电，置于高温氧气中会形成玻璃态二氧化硅。
notes: Upstream electrical and sparkle behavior is retained with an original bounded hot-oxygen route.

english_description: Platinum. Catalyzes certain reactions.
chinese_description: 铂,可以催化某些反应

english_description: Velocity sensor, creates a spark when there's a nearby particle with velocity higher than its temperature.
chinese_description: 速度探测器,当速度高于传感器温度的粒子在附近时,会生成电脉冲

english_description: Solid, melts into various elements.
chinese_description: 岩石,坚固的材料,CNCT可以堆叠在它上面

english_description: Lithium. Reactive element that explodes on contact with water.
chinese_description: 锂,与水接触会发生爆炸,可用于制造电池

english_description: Resist. Solidifies on contact with photons, is destroyed by electrons and spark.
chinese_description: 光刻胶,遇PHOT固化,会被ELEC和SPRK破坏

english_description: Solidified resist. Blocks pressure and insulates electricity. Liquefies on contact with neutrons.
chinese_description: 固化光刻胶,绝缘,遇NEUT液化,且会反射PHOT

english_description: Caustic base. Corrodes conductive solids and neutralizes acids.
chinese_description: 强腐蚀性碱液，会腐蚀导电固体并中和酸。

english_description: Seeds. Put on sand and add water to grow a tree.
chinese_description: 种子,放在沙子上时浇水会生长树木

english_description: Aluminium: Light conductive passivated metal; warm acid or caustic material releases hydrogen while molten aluminium still alloys with magnesium.
chinese_description: 铝：轻质导电且具有钝化性的金属；温热酸液或苛性物质会使其释放氢气，熔融铝仍可与镁形成合金。
notes: Concept registry only; independent implementation now combines metallurgy with original shared boron-group chemistry.
production: Place directly or cool molten ALUM then alloy it with magnesium above 950 K.
uses: Light conductor ALMG feedstock and amphoteric acid or caustic reaction experiments.
hazards: Warm acid caustic material hot oxygen or molten metal can release hydrogen heat or finite fire.
controls: Remove acid caustic material oxygen and heat then use refractory containment.
cleanup: Vent hydrogen cool generic salt residue or route pressure damage through typed recoverable BRMT.

english_description: Copper: Excellent conductor. Oxidizes in wet air; melt with tin or zinc for useful alloys.
chinese_description: 铜：优良导体，在潮湿含氧环境中会腐蚀；可与锡或锌熔炼合金。
notes: Adapted to the current API and rebalanced from Cracker COPR.cpp.
production: Place COPR or melt it for bronze and brass feedstock.
hazards: Wet oxygen can slowly corrode it into scrap.
controls: Control temperature and pressure, separate hot material, and use refractory containment.
cleanup: Collect corrosion recoverable BRMT and reheat it with its stored COPR ctype, or cool and remove it.

english_description: Lead: Dense toxic low-melting metal that absorbs neutrons and supports shielding assembly; warm acid or hot oxygen leaves metallic residue.
chinese_description: 铅：高密度有毒低熔点金属，可吸收中子并用于组装屏蔽体；温热酸液或高温氧气会留下金属残渣。
notes: Concept registry only; independent implementation now combines metallurgy with bounded carbon-group chemistry.
production: Place directly or melt beside SSIL and active NCRM for RSHD assembly.
uses: Neutron absorption shielding feedstock RSHD assembly and dense toxic-metal chemistry.
hazards: Deadly contact low pressure acid hot oxygen and molten heat require sealed containment.
controls: Use shielding sealed containment and remove pressure acid oxygen and heat.
cleanup: Collect typed recoverable BRMT cool generic salt or use molten LEAD in bounded RSHD assembly.

english_description: Tin: Soft low-melting alloy metal; prolonged cooling below 286 K makes it brittle, while molten tin can still form bronze.

notes: Original bounded moderation condition.
production: Place MODR adjacent to NFUL before adding a neutron.
uses: Required reusable condition for fuel conversion.
hazards: It does not stop official neutron behavior.
controls: Separate MODR from NFUL or place CROD beside the fuel to suppress custom conversion.
cleanup: After neutron input stops, physically recover MODR; it is reusable in the custom route.

english_description: Control Rod: Control rod suppresses adjacent custom fuel conversion without modifying neutron behavior.
chinese_description: 控制棒：控制棒抑制相邻自定义燃料转换，不修改中子行为。
notes: Original local reactor control condition.
production: Place CROD adjacent to the fuel reaction area.
uses: Local control for the custom fuel route.
hazards: It only suppresses the custom fuel conversion.
controls: Keep CROD adjacent to NFUL while shutdown is required; remove it only after neutron input stops.
cleanup: After neutron input stops, cool and physically recover CROD; it is not consumed by shutdown.

english_description: Reactor Coolant: High-capacity coolant turns into steam beside hot nuclear waste and removes part of its heat.
chinese_description: 反应堆冷却剂：高热容冷却剂在高温核废料旁转为蒸汽并带走部分热量。
notes: Original bounded coolant-to-steam route.
production: Place NCLT beside hot NWST while it is below its own steam transition.
uses: Converts waste heat into official steam.
hazards: It becomes steam and leaves a hot waste particle.
controls: Limit contact to hot NWST and provide a safe path for the resulting official steam.
cleanup: Vent or condense resulting official steam safely, then cool and isolate the remaining NWST.

english_description: Nuclear Waste: Hot radioactive waste can be cooled and stabilized with SLAG HUMS POLY WATR and reusable CATA into shield and feedstock outputs.
chinese_description: 核废料：高温放射性核废料可冷却后与炉渣、腐殖质、聚合物、水和可复用催化剂稳定化为屏蔽体及原料。
notes: Original bounded reactor by-product.
production: Run the controlled fuel route; cool NWST and combine the complete waste fixture at 500 to 620 K.
uses: Recoverable reactor by-product and trigger of the four-module waste route.
hazards: Hot or incomplete mixtures remain radioactive and can ignite nearby HUMS or POLY.
controls: Stop neutron production; cool NWST and isolate it behind RSHD before bounded stabilization.
cleanup: Stabilize cooled NWST into RSHD FLUX and NUTR with retained WATR or physically isolate it.

english_description: Neutron Generator: Sparked generator emits one stationary neutron only when reactor fuel is locally present.
chinese_description: 中子发生器：通电发生器仅在局部存在反应堆燃料时发射一粒静止中子。
notes: Original bounded triggered neutron source.
production: Spark NGEN beside NFUL with an empty local output slot.
uses: Controlled local neutron source for reactor experiments.
hazards: It can trigger hot fuel conversion when moderation is present.
controls: Stop electrical sparks, remove nearby NFUL, and block the local empty neutron output slot.
cleanup: Stop sparks and physically recover the generator after all local neutrons are absorbed.

english_description: Radiation Shield: Reusable shield assembled from SSIL molten LEAD and an active NCRM spark; it absorbs adjacent neutrons into limited heat.
chinese_description: 辐射屏蔽体：由不锈钢、熔融铅和通电镍铬火花组装的可复用屏蔽体，可吸收相邻中子并转为热量。
notes: Original bounded local neutron sink.
production: Assemble RSHD at 700 to 1200 K then place it next to an incoming local neutron.
uses: Reusable product of the metallurgy-nuclear assembly route and local neutron sink.
hazards: Repeated absorption heats it up to 1600 K.
controls: Limit neutron exposure, stop assembly sparks, and cool RSHD after absorption raises its temperature.
cleanup: Cool and physically recover RSHD after it absorbs local neutrons; it remains reusable.

english_description: Chlorine: Toxic chlorine gas reacts with hydrogen above 450 K to form hydrochloric acid.
chinese_description: 氯气：有毒氯气在 450 K 以上与氢气反应生成盐酸。
notes: Cracker chlorine concept independently rewritten with a bounded local reaction.
production: Heat CHLR beside H2 above 450 K.
uses: Exact hydrochloric-acid production for chloride chemistry.
hazards: Toxic gas becomes corrosive hydrochloric acid.
controls: Remove heat and H2, isolate the toxic gas, and avoid creating hydrochloric acid.
cleanup: Consume CHLR through the registered hydrochloric-acid path under containment, or isolate and physically remove it.

english_description: Ammonia: Toxic ammonia made from nitrogen and hydrogen over a sparked catalyst.
chinese_description: 氨气：由氮气和氢气在通电催化剂上制备的有毒氨气。
notes: Original bounded Haber-style game approximation.
production: Use a sparked catalyst with nitrogen hydrogen pressure and the documented temperature window.
hazards: Toxic gas reacts with acid into fertilizer.
controls: Remove catalyst sparks and pressure, isolate the toxic gas, or neutralize it through the FERT route.
cleanup: Neutralize AMON through the registered fertilizer route, or isolate and physically remove it.

english_description: Ethanol: Flammable ethanol produced by warm yeast fermentation near plant matter and water.
chinese_description: 乙醇：由温暖酵母在植物和水附近发酵产生的易燃乙醇。
notes: Seppo token concept independently implemented as a bounded fermentation path.
production: Place yeast beside plant and water in the warm fermentation window.
hazards: It is flammable and can ignite from fire.
controls: Remove FIRE and heat, separate oxidizers, and contain the flammable liquid.
cleanup: Use ETHL as registered fuel or isolate, cool, and physically remove the flammable residue.

english_description: Kerosene: Mid-range fuel made by heating oil beside a catalyst and cracked further into gasoline or acetylene.
chinese_description: 煤油：由原油在催化剂旁加热制得的中馏分燃料，可进一步裂化为汽油或乙炔。
notes: Seppo token and Cyens hydrocarbon-chain concepts independently implemented.
production: Heat CATA beside OIL above 500 K.
uses: Intermediate fuel for gasoline or acetylene routes.
hazards: It is flammable and further heating changes the product.
controls: Remove heat and catalyst contact, separate FIRE, and contain the flammable fuel.
cleanup: Process KERO through registered downstream fuel routes, or isolate and physically remove it.

english_description: Gasoline: Volatile high-energy fuel cracked from kerosene over a catalyst.
chinese_description: 汽油：由煤油在催化剂上裂化得到的挥发性高能燃料。
notes: Seppo token and Cyens hydrocarbon-chain concepts independently implemented.
production: Heat catalyst beside kerosene above 650 K.
hazards: It is flammable and can ignite from fire.
controls: Remove FIRE and heat, separate oxidizers, and contain the high-energy fuel.
cleanup: Use GASO as controlled fuel, or remove ignition sources and physically remove the residue.

english_description: Acetylene: Reactive high-energy gas made by hot catalytic cracking and cyclised into benzene beside a hot catalyst.
chinese_description: 乙炔：由高温催化裂化制得的高能反应气体，可在高温催化剂旁环化为苯。
notes: Cracker token concept independently implemented with bounded reactions.
production: Use a hot catalyst for cracking or cyclise three acetylene particles beside a hot catalyst.
uses: Reactive fuel gas and aromatic feedstock.
hazards: Reactive flammable gas can ignite from fire.
controls: Remove FIRE and hot catalyst contact, then isolate the reactive flammable gas.
cleanup: Cyclise ACTY through the registered CATA route, or isolate and physically remove it.

english_description: Catalyst: Reusable catalyst for fuels polymers peroxide control mild slag acid treatment and cooled waste stabilization.
chinese_description: 催化剂：用于燃料、聚合、过氧化物控制、温和炉渣酸处理和冷却废物稳定化的可复用催化剂。
notes: Original central chemistry process material.
production: Place CATA beside registered inputs and use the required heat spark or recovery window.
uses: Reusable local catalyst for chemistry and cross-module recovery routes.
hazards: High heat corrosive acid and radioactive waste require containment.
controls: Remove heat or sparks and separate CATA from registered reagent pairs.
cleanup: Cool and physically recover CATA after reagent separation; registered reactions keep it reusable.

english_description: Polyethylene: Insulating polymer made from ethylene and usable for encapsulating cooled nuclear waste.
chinese_description: 聚乙烯：由乙烯制成的绝缘聚合物，可用于封装冷却后的核废料。
notes: Existing generic POLY stable ID refined into the canonical polyethylene implementation.
production: Use two ethylene particles around a moderately hot catalyst or combine POLY with cooled NWST and the complete waste fixture.
uses: Insulating polyethylene structure and cross-module waste encapsulation input.
hazards: Heat above 900 K can ignite POLY; missing water catalyst or companion waste leaves it unchanged.
controls: Remove heat or spark input; separate reagents and contain radioactive waste during stabilization.
cleanup: Consume POLY in the bounded RSHD route or physically recover unused polyethylene.

english_description: Hydrogen Peroxide: Spark-made peroxide treats PATH at 285 to 330 K; hot catalyst instead drives decomposition.
chinese_description: 过氧化氢：通电催化制得的过氧化氢可在 285 至 330 K 处理病原体；高温催化剂会使其转入分解。
notes: Original bounded electrochemical approximation.
production: Make PERO with sparked CATA then use it on PATH in the treatment window or decompose it beside hot CATA.
uses: Oxidizing intermediate oxygen source and biology-treatment reagent.
hazards: Hot CATA preempts treatment and decomposition can release local oxygen.
controls: Remove hot CATA or separate PERO from PATH to stop treatment; isolate oxidizers.
cleanup: Convert PATH to HUMS and WATR or decompose excess PERO under containment.

english_description: Fertilizer: Ammonia-derived fertilizer supports wet plants or recovers wet HUMS into NUTR and DUST.
chinese_description: 肥料：氨气中和酸液制得的肥料可支持湿润植物，或把湿润腐殖质回收为营养盐和尘埃。
notes: Original bounded plant-support loop.
production: Neutralize ammonia with acid then use FERT beside wet plants or wet HUMS at 285 to 315 K.
uses: Supports official plants and closes the Omni biology nutrient loop.
hazards: It is consumed into DUST during plant support or HUMS recovery.
controls: Separate FERT from WATR and HUMS or leave the composting window to stop recovery.
cleanup: Consume FERT in a controlled plant or HUMS route or physically recover unused fertilizer.

english_description: Helium: Very light inert gas with exceptional heat conduction and cryogenic heat exchange below 20 K. Electrical discharge produces a pale photon glow.
chinese_description: 氦：极轻的惰性气体，导热性很高，在 20 K 以下进行低温换热；放电时产生淡色光子辉光。
notes: Original family-generated implementation using the shared bounded noble-gas update.
production: Directly placeable in the unrestricted sandbox with no unlock or production prerequisite.
uses: Cryogenic heat-transfer experiments and low-density inert atmospheres.
hazards: Nonflammable but its very low game temperature can rapidly cool nearby materials.
controls: Only local 3x3 checks run under the shared 1024-event-per-frame periodic budget.
cleanup: Erase or vent the gas; all emitted photons have a finite lifetime.

english_description: Beryllium: Hard light but toxic alkaline-earth metal; it resists cool water, reacts with warm acid, and oxidizes only when very hot.
chinese_description: 铍：坚硬、轻质但有毒的碱土金属；冷水中较稳定，能与温热酸反应，仅在很高温度下氧化。
notes: Original family-generated implementation with explicit passivation and toxicity differences.
production: Direct placement or cooling its own molten LAVA phase below 1560 K.
uses: Light hard metal passivation warm-acid hydrogen and high-temperature oxidation experiments.
hazards: Toxic contact; warm acid extreme heat or hot steam can release hydrogen heat and finite fire.
controls: Use sealed dry containment and remove acid steam oxygen and heat.
cleanup: Vent hydrogen cool generic salt or caustic residue and isolate remaining toxic metal.

english_description: Boron: Hard metalloid powder that captures local neutrons into lithium and helium proxies and forms a glassy oxide only when very hot.
chinese_description: 硼：坚硬的类金属粉末，可将局部中子俘获为锂和氦，并仅在很高温度下形成玻璃态氧化物。
notes: Original family-generated implementation with bounded local neutron capture and high-temperature oxidation.
production: Direct placement or cooling its own molten LAVA phase below 2349 K.
uses: Neutron absorption shielding experiments and high-temperature glassy oxide formation.
hazards: Neutron capture releases bounded heat while hot oxygen can create finite fire.
controls: Remove neutrons oxygen and heat or isolate boron behind containment.
cleanup: Recover generated LITH and HE or cool the GLAS proxy after oxidation.

english_description: Nitrogen: Stable atmospheric gas that condenses into liquid nitrogen below 77 K and gains a violet glow near a local discharge.
chinese_description: 氮：常温稳定气体，低于 77 K 会凝结为液氮，邻近局部放电时产生紫色辉光。
notes: Original family-generated nitrogen gas linked to the retained official LNTG and NICE low-temperature phases.
production: Place directly or warm official LNTG above 77 K after thawing NICE.
uses: Atmosphere cryogenic phase and finite discharge-glow experiments.
hazards: Cryogenic contact high-energy discharge and plasma temperatures require controlled handling.
controls: Remove electrical sources and control temperature with insulated containment.
cleanup: Condense to LNTG freeze to NICE or vent the gas after the glow expires.

english_description: Fluorine: Extremely reactive pale gas that forms acid with water or hydrogen and rapidly turns reactive metals into halide salts.
chinese_description: 氟：反应性极强的浅色气体，会与水或氢气形成酸液，并迅速把活泼金属转化为卤化盐。
notes: Original family-generated fluorine implementation with bounded local corrosion and acid formation.
production: Direct placement provides the room-temperature gas with no unlock or synthesis prerequisite.
uses: Strong oxidizer water acid metal-halide and disinfection experiments.
hazards: Deadly contact rapid corrosion acid heat and pressure require sealed dry containment.
controls: Remove water hydrogen reactive metal and biological targets then ventilate the gas.
cleanup: Neutralise finite acid and salt residues or erase the isolated gas.

english_description: Neon: Light inert gas that produces a strong red-orange glow during an electrical discharge.
chinese_description: 氖：轻质惰性气体，通电时会发出强烈的红橙色辉光。
notes: Original family-generated implementation using the shared bounded noble-gas update.
production: Directly placeable in the unrestricted sandbox with no unlock or production prerequisite.
uses: Coloured discharge tubes and inert-atmosphere electrical experiments.
hazards: Nonflammable and chemically inert in this simplified game model.
controls: Only local 3x3 checks run under the shared 1024-event-per-frame periodic budget.
cleanup: Erase or vent the gas; all emitted photons have a finite lifetime.

english_description: Sodium: Soft conductive alkali metal; water produces hydrogen and a caustic residue, while acid produces salt residue with heat and pressure.
chinese_description: 钠：柔软导电的碱金属；遇水产生氢气和苛性残留物，遇酸生成盐类残留物，并释放热量和压力。
notes: Original family-generated implementation using the shared bounded alkali-metal update.
production: Direct placement or cooling its own molten LAVA phase below 370.87 K.
uses: Water hydrogen and caustic-residue experiments plus acid salt formation.
hazards: Water acid and hot oxygen release heat pressure and sometimes finite fire.
controls: Remove water acid oxygen and ignition sources or isolate the metal behind dry containment.
cleanup: Consume it through a bounded water acid or oxygen route then vent hydrogen and cool residues.

english_description: Phosphorus: Toxic low-melting reactive powder that burns in warm oxygen, producing oxide dust and pale fire.
chinese_description: 磷：有毒且低熔点的活泼粉末，在温热氧气中燃烧并生成氧化物粉尘和浅色火焰。
notes: Original family-generated reactive phosphorus proxy with bounded oxidation and vaporisation.
production: Place directly or cool LAVA(P) below 317.3 K.
uses: Low-temperature phase oxygen combustion and finite vaporisation experiments.
hazards: Toxic contact warm oxygen fire and hot vapor require sealed handling.
controls: Remove oxygen and heat then isolate the reactive powder from ignition.
cleanup: Cool oxide dust or wait for finite fire and vapor proxies to expire.

english_description: Sulfur: Low-melting yellow combustible powder that burns in warm oxygen into a sulfur-oxide smoke material.
chinese_description: 硫：低熔点黄色可燃粉末，在温热氧气中燃烧并形成短寿命的硫氧化物烟雾。
notes: Original family-generated sulfur implementation with bounded oxidation and vaporisation.
production: Place directly or cool LAVA(S) below 388.4 K.
uses: Combustion low-melting phase and sulfur-oxide smoke-proxy experiments.
hazards: Fire hot oxygen and finite oxide smoke require ventilation and heat control.
controls: Remove oxygen heat and ignition then ventilate the finite smoke proxy.
cleanup: Cool molten sulfur below its melting point or wait for finite fire and smoke to expire.

english_description: Argon: Inert gas with moderate density and low heat conduction. Electrical excitation produces a violet photon glow.
chinese_description: 氩：中等密度且导热较低的惰性气体，电激发时产生紫色光子辉光。
notes: Original family-generated implementation using the shared bounded noble-gas update.
production: Directly placeable in the unrestricted sandbox with no unlock or production prerequisite.
uses: Inert shielding atmospheres and moderate-density discharge experiments.
hazards: Nonflammable but dense accumulations can displace reactive gases.
controls: Only local 3x3 checks run under the shared 1024-event-per-frame periodic budget.
cleanup: Erase or vent the gas; all emitted photons have a finite lifetime.

english_description: Potassium: Low-melting alkali metal whose water acid and oxygen reactions are stronger than sodium but remain locally budgeted.
chinese_description: 钾：低熔点碱金属，水、酸和氧反应强于钠，但只与附近物质反应。
notes: Original family-generated implementation using the shared bounded alkali-metal update.

hazards: Water acid and hot oxygen create stronger local heat pressure and finite fire.
controls: Keep dry and separate from acids oxidizers and ignition sources.
cleanup: Consume it in a bounded reaction then vent hydrogen cool residues and remove remaining oxidizers.

english_description: Calcium: Reactive light metal; water produces hydrogen and a caustic residue, while hot oxygen produces an orange-red flame.
chinese_description: 钙：活泼轻金属；遇水产生氢气和苛性残留物，在高温氧气中产生的橙红色火焰。
notes: Original family-generated implementation with a calcium flame signature.
production: Direct placement or cooling its own molten LAVA phase below 1115 K.
uses: Water hydrogen acid salt and orange-red flame experiments plus future lime-system input.
hazards: Water acid and hot oxygen release bounded heat pressure hydrogen and finite fire.
controls: Keep dry remove acid oxygen and ignition and isolate bulk samples.
cleanup: Vent hydrogen cool residues and remove remaining water acid or oxidizer.

english_description: Scandium: Lightweight conductive transition metal that reacts with warm acid, oxidizes when hot and gives a blue discharge-lamp glow.
chinese_description: 钪：轻质导电过渡金属，会与温热酸液反应、高温氧化，并在放电时产生蓝色灯光辉光。
notes: Original first-transition-series implementation with bounded acid oxidation vaporisation and discharge behavior.

uses: Discharge-lamp glow acid corrosion hot oxidation and phase-change experiments.
hazards: Acid hydrogen hot oxygen molten heat and finite metal vapour require controlled handling.

cleanup: Vent hydrogen cool typed scrap and wait for finite photon or vapour proxies to expire.

english_description: Vanadium: Hard high-melting transition metal that reacts slowly with acid and alloys with molten steel to form a tool-steel material.
chinese_description: 钒：硬而高熔点的过渡金属，与酸反应较慢，并可和熔融钢形成工具钢。
notes: Original first-transition-series implementation with a bounded molten tool-steel route.
production: Direct placement or cooling typed LAVA(V) below 2183 K.
uses: High-temperature tool-steel alloy acid corrosion oxidation and phase-change experiments.
hazards: Molten steel acid hydrogen hot oxygen and metal vapour require refractory containment.
controls: Separate acid and oxygen then control steel temperature before alloying.
cleanup: Cool typed TSTL lava or recover typed scrap after oxidation.

english_description: Manganese: Hard brittle transition metal that reacts readily with acid and deoxidizes hot molten iron into a steel and slag.
chinese_description: 锰：硬而脆的过渡金属，会较快与酸反应，并把高温熔融铁脱氧为钢和炉渣。
notes: Original first-transition-series implementation with a bounded steel deoxidation route.
production: Direct placement or cooling typed LAVA(MN) below 1519 K.
uses: Steel deoxidation acid corrosion oxidation brittleness and phase-change experiments.
hazards: Acid hydrogen oxygen molten iron hot slag and metal vapour require controlled handling.
controls: Use refractory containment and keep unintended oxygen or acid away from molten batches.
cleanup: Cool typed STEL lava and SLAG or recover typed manganese scrap.

english_description: Gallium: Conductive metal that melts near room temperature; liquid gallium locally embrittles aluminium into recoverable recoverable scrap.
chinese_description: 镓：接近室温即可熔化的导电金属；液态镓会在局部把铝脆化为可回收的可回收碎料。
notes: Original family-generated low-melting and bounded aluminium-embrittlement implementation.
production: Direct placement or cooling its own molten LAVA phase below 302.91 K.
uses: Low-melting metal acid or caustic chemistry and aluminium embrittlement experiments.

chinese_description: 氢-3：放射性氚气体，会以贝塔衰变转为氦并释放一个电子；邻近火焰、等离子体或熔岩也可能先将其点燃。
notes: Original bounded tritium decay proxy.

cleanup: Wait for bounded decay to helium or remove ignition and vent finite fire.

english_description: Carbon-14: Radioactive carbon tracer powder with slow beta decay to nitrogen.
chinese_description: 碳-14：放射性碳示踪粉末，会以较慢的贝塔衰变转为氮。
notes: Original bounded carbon tracer isotope.
production: Place directly as a representative isotope tracer.

cleanup: Wait for decay to nitrogen or remove the isolated sample.

english_description: Cobalt-60: Neutron-activated cobalt source with medium lifetime and strong gamma emission before becoming nickel.
chinese_description: 钴-60：由中子活化钴得到的中等寿命辐射源，强伽马衰变后转为镍。

cleanup: Wait for decay to nickel and cool the remaining metal.

english_description: Strontium-90: Persistent beta-emitting fission product that decays to yttrium with heat.
chinese_description: 锶-90：持久的贝塔裂变产物，以热量衰变为钇。

production: Place directly or obtain it as one bounded fissile-isotope product.
uses: Long-lived waste beta-source and shielding comparisons.
hazards: Persistent electron radiation and decay heat remain after fission.

cleanup: Allow decay to yttrium then cool or recover the metal.

english_description: Iodine-131: Short-lived low-melting fission product with gamma decay to xenon.
chinese_description: 碘-131：短寿命低熔点裂变产物，会伽马衰变为氙。

cleanup: Wait for decay to xenon then vent the inert gas.

english_description: Caesium-137: Mobile gamma-emitting fission product that decays to barium after a medium lifetime.
chinese_description: 铯-137：易迁移的伽马裂变产物，在中等寿命后衰变为钡。
notes: Original bounded caesium contamination isotope.
production: Place directly or obtain it as one bounded fissile-isotope product.
uses: Contamination spread gamma shielding and waste handling experiments.

cleanup: Wait for decay to barium then recover the stable product.

english_description: Thorium-232: Fertile alpha-emitting isotope that becomes reactor fuel after neutron capture.
chinese_description: 钍-232：可育的阿尔法放射性核素，俘获中子后可转变为反应堆燃料。

cleanup: Cool and isolate generic fuel or wait for decay to radium.

english_description: Uranium-235: Fissile isotope that needs a local moderator and neutron while control rods suppress its fission.
chinese_description: 铀-235：易裂变核素，需要邻近慢化剂和中子；控制棒会抑制其裂变。

english_description: Uranium-238: Fertile isotope that captures one local neutron into plutonium-239 with heat.
chinese_description: 铀-238：可育核素，可俘获一个邻近中子并以热量转为钚-239。

english_description: Plutonium-239: Fissile isotope bred from uranium-238 and controlled by moderator and control-rod placement.
chinese_description: 钚-239：可由铀-238育成的易裂变核素，其裂变受慢化剂和控制棒布置控制。

production: Place directly or expose uranium-238 to one local neutron.
uses: Breeding controlled fission and high-temperature fuel experiments.
hazards: Fission heat pressure bounded neutron and waste products require shielding.
controls: Use control rods cooling and neutron isolation.
cleanup: Separate fission products or wait for slow alpha decay to uranium.

english_description: Americium-241: Medium-lived alpha source that decays to neptunium with heat.
chinese_description: 镅-241：中等寿命的阿尔法源，以热量衰变为镎。
notes: Original bounded americium source and waste isotope.
production: Place directly as a representative source isotope.
uses: Alpha-source detector smoke-source proxy and waste experiments.
hazards: Decay heat and radioactive helium production require containment.
controls: Use small shielded samples and passive cooling.
cleanup: Wait for decay to neptunium then continue shielded storage.

english_description: Californium-252: Short-lived strong neutron source with spontaneous and induced fission behavior.
chinese_description: 锎-252：短寿命的强中子源，具有自发和诱发裂变行为。

production: Place directly as a representative artificial neutron source.

cleanup: Wait for decay to curium and absorb remaining neutrons.

english_description: Methane: Light flammable gas made by catalytic carbon-dioxide hydrogen conversion and consumed by hot steam reforming.
chinese_description: 甲烷：轻质可燃气体，可由二氧化碳和氢的催化反应制得，并在高温蒸汽重整中消耗。
notes: Original bounded methane and steam-reforming implementation.
production: Place directly or combine carbon dioxide and hydrogen beside a 500 to 850 K catalyst.
uses: Light fuel gas and steam-reforming feedstock.
hazards: Highly flammable gas can spread fire and pressure.
controls: Remove fire heat and catalyst contact then ventilate.
cleanup: Reform it with steam or allow controlled finite fire to expire.

english_description: Ethane: Flammable hydrocarbon gas that a hot catalyst cracks into ethylene and one hydrogen particle.
chinese_description: 乙烷：可燃烃气体，可在高温催化剂旁裂化为乙烯和一个氢粒子。
notes: Original bounded ethane cracking implementation.
production: Place directly or recover it as one bounded butane-cracking product.
hazards: Flammable gas and released hydrogen increase ignition risk.
controls: Remove heat catalyst and ignition sources then ventilate.
cleanup: Crack it into ethylene and hydrogen or burn it under control.

english_description: Propane: Dense flammable gas that liquefies under pressure or cracks into ethylene and methane beside a hot catalyst.
chinese_description: 丙烷：较重的可燃气体，会在压力下液化，或在高温催化剂旁裂化为乙烯和甲烷。

production: Place directly as a distinct liquefiable fuel gas.

cleanup: Crack it into ethylene and methane or vent the cooled gas.

english_description: Butane: Heavy flammable gas that liquefies under lower pressure or cracks into ethylene and ethane beside a hot catalyst.
chinese_description: 丁烷：重质可燃气体，会在较低压力下液化，或在高温催化剂旁裂化为乙烯和乙烷。
notes: Original bounded butane phase and cracking behavior.
production: Place directly as the heaviest precise alkane in this batch.
uses: Dense fuel storage and staged hydrocarbon cracking.
hazards: It liquefies easily and remains strongly flammable.
controls: Release pressure remove catalyst heat and isolate ignition.
cleanup: Crack it into ethylene and ethane or contain the cooled product.

english_description: Ethylene: Reactive unsaturated gas that two-particle catalytic polymerisation converts into polyethylene.
chinese_description: 乙烯：活泼的不饱和气体，两粒子催化聚合会生成聚乙烯。
notes: Original bounded ethylene and canonical polyethylene route.
production: Crack ethane propane or butane beside a hot catalyst or place it directly.
uses: Reactive fuel gas and polyethylene feedstock.
hazards: Flammable gas can polymerise or ignite near heat.
controls: Remove ignition and keep catalyst outside the 430 to 650 K window.
cleanup: Polymerise pairs into stable POLY or ventilate the gas.

english_description: Methanol: Toxic volatile alcohol whose catalytic oxidation yields carbon monoxide and water.
chinese_description: 甲醇：有毒挥发性醇，催化氧化会生成一氧化碳和水。
notes: Original bounded methanol oxidation and vapour proxy.
production: Place directly as a distinct toxic alcohol and solvent.
uses: Volatile solvent oxidation and aromatic-feedstock experiments.
hazards: Toxic flammable vapour and carbon monoxide can spread.
controls: Remove oxygen catalyst heat and ignition then ventilate.
cleanup: Oxidise it under control or consume it in toluene synthesis.

english_description: Acetone: Volatile toxic solvent produced by heating acetic acid beside a catalyst; it vaporises readily.
chinese_description: 丙酮：挥发性有毒溶剂，可由乙酸在催化剂旁受热制得，并且很容易汽化。
notes: Cyens GPL acetone concept rewritten with current bounded chemistry and no copied update function.
production: Heat two acetic-acid particles beside a catalyst to obtain acetone carbon dioxide and water.
uses: Volatile solvent and organic phase comparison.
hazards: Toxic flammable vapour spreads rapidly when heated.
controls: Cool and ventilate while removing heat and ignition.
cleanup: Allow vapour to disperse in a controlled space or remove the solvent.

english_description: Benzene: Toxic aromatic liquid made by catalytic cyclisation of three acetylene particles.
chinese_description: 苯：有毒芳香液体，由三粒乙炔进行催化环化制得。
notes: Original bounded aromatic synthesis implementation.
production: Cyclise three acetylene particles beside a catalyst at 750 K or higher.
hazards: Toxic flammable liquid and vapour require containment.
controls: Remove catalyst heat and flame then ventilate behind barriers.
cleanup: Consume it in bounded toluene synthesis or isolate it.

english_description: Toluene: Toxic aromatic solvent made from benzene and methanol over a hot catalyst.
chinese_description: 甲苯：有毒芳香溶剂，由苯和甲醇在高温催化剂旁制得。
notes: Original bounded toluene synthesis and vapour proxy.
production: React benzene with methanol beside a catalyst at 500 K or higher.
uses: Aromatic solvent fuel and organic material comparison.
hazards: Toxic flammable vapour spreads on heating.
controls: Remove catalyst heat and ignition then ventilate.
cleanup: Cool and isolate the solvent or consume it in later organic routes.

english_description: Glycerol: Viscous organic liquid recovered during fat saponification and used in a reactive nitration route.
chinese_description: 甘油：油脂皂化时可回收的黏稠有机液体，也可参与硝化反应。
notes: Original bounded glycerol and deliberately abstract high-energy proxy.
production: Recover it from warm fat and caustic saponification or place it directly.
uses: Viscous organic feedstock and game-only high-energy comparison.
hazards: Hot nitric acid contact creates official pressure-sensitive NITR in the game.
controls: Keep nitric acid and heat separated from glycerol.
cleanup: Use it in later polymer routes or isolate and cool it.

english_description: Acetic Acid: Weak organic acid produced by catalytic ethanol oxidation and converted at high heat into acetone, carbon dioxide, and water.
chinese_description: 乙酸：弱有机酸，由乙醇催化氧化制得，并在高温下转化为丙酮、二氧化碳和水。
notes: Original bounded weak-acid oxidation and ketonisation network.
production: Oxidise ethanol beside oxygen and a warm catalyst or place it directly.
uses: Weak organic acid and acetone feedstock.
hazards: Corrosive toxic liquid becomes volatile when heated.
controls: Remove oxygen catalyst and heat then contain the acid.
cleanup: Convert pairs into acetone or neutralise by physical removal.

english_description: Urea: Nitrogen-rich powder made from ammonia and carbon dioxide under warm pressure and hydrolysed into ammonia water and carbon dioxide.
chinese_description: 尿素：富氮粉末，由氨和二氧化碳在温热压力下制得，水解后生成氨水和二氧化碳。
notes: Cyens GPL urea concept rewritten with current synthesis hydrolysis and bounded budget.

uses: Nitrogen fertilizer feedstock and hydrolysis experiment.
hazards: Heating releases ammonia while warm wet catalysis produces ammonia water.
controls: Remove heat water and catalyst then ventilate ammonia products.
cleanup: Hydrolyse it under control or recover the dry powder.

english_description: Fats: Viscous organic oil that warm caustic treatment converts into soap and glycerol.
chinese_description: 油脂：黏稠有机油，温热苛性处理会将其转化为肥皂和甘油。
notes: Original bounded fat saponification implementation distinct from petroleum OIL.
production: Place directly as biological oil distinct from official petroleum OIL.
uses: Soap glycerol and viscous organic-material experiments.
hazards: Hot fat burns or decomposes into smoke while caustic contact reacts.
controls: Remove heat flame and caustic material then contain the oil.
cleanup: Convert it to official SOAP and GLYC or cool and recover it.

english_description: Glucose: Fermentable sugar powder obtained by starch or cellulose hydrolysis and consumed by yeast.
chinese_description: 葡萄糖：可发酵糖粉末，可由淀粉或纤维素水解制得，并被酵母消耗。

english_description: Starch: Combustible biopolymer powder that warm water and catalyst hydrolyse into glucose.
chinese_description: 淀粉：可燃生物聚合物粉末，温水和催化剂会将其水解为葡萄糖。

chinese_description: 纤维素：不同于生长植物和结构木材的纤维状可燃固体，可较慢地催化水解为葡萄糖。

cleanup: Hydrolyse it into glucose or isolate the solid.

english_description: Propylene: Flammable unsaturated gas whose two-particle catalytic polymerisation produces polypropylene.
chinese_description: 丙烯：可燃不饱和气体，两粒子催化聚合会生成聚丙烯。

english_description: Butadiene: Reactive flammable gas whose catalytic pairing produces rubber.
chinese_description: 丁二烯：活泼可燃气体，催化配对会生成橡胶。

cleanup: Polymerise pairs into RUBR or vent the gas.

english_description: Vinyl Chloride: Toxic flammable monomer gas that polymerises into PVC without overriding chlorine.
chinese_description: 氯乙烯：有毒可燃单体气体，可聚合为聚氯乙烯且不覆盖氯气。

hazards: Toxic flammable gas can ignite or polymerise.
controls: Remove heat flame and catalyst then ventilate behind barriers.
cleanup: Polymerise pairs into PVCL or isolate the gas.

english_description: Styrene: Toxic volatile aromatic liquid that polymerises into low-conductivity polystyrene.
chinese_description: 苯乙烯：有毒挥发性芳香液体，可聚合为低导热的聚苯乙烯。

cleanup: Polymerise pairs into PSTY or cool and contain it.

english_description: Tetrafluoroethylene: Reactive toxic fluorinated gas whose polymerisation produces heat-resistant PTFE.
chinese_description: 四氟乙烯：活泼有毒含氟气体，聚合会生成耐热聚四氟乙烯。

english_description: Adipic Acid: Organic acid powder that condenses with diamine beside a warm catalyst to produce nylon and water.
chinese_description: 己二酸：有机酸粉末，可与己二胺在温热催化剂旁缩合生成尼龙和水。

cleanup: Condense it into NYLN or recover the powder.

english_description: Diamine: Toxic nylon precursor powder consumed with adipic acid in the condensation route.
chinese_description: 己二胺：有毒尼龙原料粉末，在缩合路线中与己二酸一起消耗。

uses: Nylon feedstock and toxic powder containment.

cleanup: Condense it into NYLN and water or isolate it.

english_description: Epoxy Resin: Viscous uncured resin that pairs beside a warm catalyst to become hard cured epoxy.
chinese_description: 环氧树脂：黏稠未固化树脂，可在温热催化剂旁配对变成坚硬的固化环氧。

english_description: Polypropylene: Light insulating thermoplastic with a lower softening point than polyethylene.
chinese_description: 聚丙烯：轻质绝缘热塑材料，软化温度低于聚乙烯。
notes: Original polymer property profile distinct from POLY.

english_description: Polyvinyl Chloride: Dense low-flammability plastic that releases chlorine and smoke only under strong heat.
chinese_description: 聚氯乙烯：致密低可燃塑料，仅在强热下释放氯气和烟。

english_description: Polystyrene: Light brittle insulating plastic that softens earlier and burns more readily than nylon or PTFE.
chinese_description: 聚苯乙烯：轻质脆性绝缘塑料，比尼龙或聚四氟乙烯更早软化且更易燃。

cleanup: Cool the softened proxy or isolate the solid.

english_description: Nylon: Tough insulating engineering polymer made by adipic-acid and diamine condensation.
chinese_description: 尼龙：由己二酸和己二胺缩合制得的坚韧绝缘工程聚合物。

production: Condense ADIP and DIAM beside warm CATA or place directly.

cleanup: Cool the softened proxy or recover the solid.

english_description: Rubber: Soft low-conductivity elastic material made from butadiene and deforming into paste under extreme pressure.
chinese_description: 橡胶：由丁二烯制得的柔软低导热弹性材料，在极端压力下会变为糊状物。

english_description: Cured Epoxy: Hard thermoset produced from uncured epoxy resin and resistant to ordinary softening.
chinese_description: 固化环氧：由未固化环氧树脂制得的坚硬热固材料，不会像普通热塑材料那样轻易软化。

uses: Hard insulating binder and heat-resistance comparison.

english_description: Polytetrafluoroethylene: Non-flammable low-conductivity fluoropolymer that remains stable to much higher heat than common plastics.
chinese_description: 聚四氟乙烯：不可燃低导热含氟聚合物，比常见塑料能承受高得多的温度。

hazards: Only extreme heat decomposes the material.

cleanup: Cool and recover the stable solid.

english_description: Bitumen: Heavy dark petroleum residue made from heated oil; it softens back into oil when warmed.
chinese_description: 沥青：石油加热后留下的重质深色残余物，受热时会重新软化为油。
notes: Distinct heavy residue while official OIL remains canonical petroleum and lubricant.

cleanup: Cool the residue or contain softened official OIL.

english_description: Ethyl Acetate: Volatile toxic solvent produced by acetic-acid and ethanol esterification.
chinese_description: 乙酸乙酯：由乙酸和乙醇进行酯化制得的挥发性有毒溶剂。

cleanup: Cool and contain the liquid or disperse vapour safely.

english_description: Gallium Arsenide: Photoconductive semiconductor made from gallium and arsenic; incoming light can trigger an electrical pulse.
chinese_description: 砷化镓：由镓和砷制得的光电半导体，受到光照时会产生电脉冲。

cleanup: Cool the material or separate unused gallium and arsenic feedstock.

english_description: Gallium Nitride: Heat-resistant semiconductor that emits blue light when electrically pulsed.
chinese_description: 氮化镓：耐热半导体，通入电脉冲时会发出蓝光。
notes: Original electronic-material implementation.

english_description: Ferrite: Resistive magnetic ceramic that turns an incoming electrical pulse into heat instead of passing it onward.
chinese_description: 铁氧体：高电阻磁性陶瓷，会把输入的电脉冲转化为热量而不继续传递。

english_description: Permanent Magnet: Dense magnetic material that bends nearby electrons and attracts iron powder.
chinese_description: 永磁材料：致密磁性材料，会偏转附近电子并吸引铁粉。
notes: Original electronic-material implementation.
production: Place directly or combine neodymium, iron and boron beside a hot catalyst.
hazards: Moving electrons and attracted iron can disturb nearby structures.
controls: Remove loose iron and electron sources before moving the magnet.
cleanup: Collect attracted iron and reuse the intact magnetic material.

english_description: Soft Magnet: Conductive magnetic material that becomes temporarily magnetised beside a spark and gradually loses the field.
chinese_description: 软磁材料：导电磁性材料，邻近火花会使其暂时磁化，随后逐渐退磁。
notes: Original electronic-material implementation.
production: Place directly or combine iron and silicon beside a hot catalyst.
uses: Temporary magnetic circuits, switching and field-decay experiments.
hazards: Repeated sparks add heat and can keep the material magnetised.
controls: Remove current and allow the field and heat to dissipate.
cleanup: Cool and reuse the soft magnetic material after demagnetisation.

english_description: Piezoelectric Ceramic: Strong insulating ceramic that produces a spark and pressure pulse when compressed.
chinese_description: 压电陶瓷：坚固的绝缘陶瓷，受到较大压力时会产生火花和压力脉冲。
notes: Original electronic-material implementation.
production: Place directly or combine lead, zirconium and titanium dioxide beside a hot catalyst.
uses: Pressure sensing, pulse generation and insulating-ceramic experiments.
hazards: Sudden pressure produces electrical and mechanical pulses.
controls: Release pressure, remove conductors and isolate the ceramic.
cleanup: Recover intact ceramic after pressure and sparks subside.

english_description: Thermoelectric Material: Conductive bismuth-tellurium material that produces a spark across a steep temperature difference and transfers heat slowly.
chinese_description: 热电材料：导电的铋碲材料，温差较大时会产生火花并缓慢传热。
notes: Original electronic-material implementation.
production: Place directly or combine bismuth and tellurium beside a warm catalyst.
uses: Thermoelectric sensing, heat-flow and temperature-gradient experiments.
hazards: Large temperature differences produce current and move heat.
controls: Equalise temperatures and disconnect nearby conductors.
cleanup: Cool both sides and reuse the material after sparks stop.

english_description: Superconductor: Ceramic conductor that carries current below its critical temperature and stops conducting when warmed.
chinese_description: 超导材料：低于临界温度时可传导电流，升温后会失去超导状态。
notes: Original electronic-material implementation.
production: Place directly or combine yttrium, barium, copper oxide and oxygen beside a hot catalyst.
uses: Cryogenic conduction, switching and thermal-threshold experiments.
hazards: Cryogenic material warms quickly when exposed to current or hot surroundings.
controls: Disconnect current and let the material warm or cool in a controlled chamber.
cleanup: Return it below the critical temperature to restore conduction.

english_description: Graphene: Thin highly conductive carbon sheet with excellent heat spreading and photon transmission; hot oxygen gradually oxidises it.
chinese_description: 石墨烯：薄层高导电碳材料，导热性强且允许光子通过，在高温氧气中会逐渐氧化。
notes: Original electronic-material implementation.
production: Place directly or compress graphite anode material beside a hot catalyst.
uses: High-conductivity sheets, heat spreading and photon-transmission experiments.
hazards: Hot oxygen consumes the carbon and releases carbon dioxide.
controls: Remove oxygen and heat, then release pressure gradually.
cleanup: Cool intact sheets or collect the carbon-dioxide product.

english_description: Carbon Nanotube: Strong conductive carbon nanomaterial that collapses into graphene under extreme pressure.
chinese_description: 碳纳米管：高强度导电碳纳米材料，在极端压力下会塌缩为石墨烯。
notes: Original electronic-material implementation.
production: Place directly or combine two graphene particles beside a hot catalyst.
uses: Strong conductive structures, pressure response and nanocarbon experiments.
hazards: Extreme pressure permanently changes the nanotube structure.
controls: Release pressure and keep the material away from hot oxygen.
cleanup: Recover graphene after collapse or reuse intact nanotubes.

english_description: Aerogel: Extremely light transparent thermal insulator that collapses into quartz under pressure.
chinese_description: 气凝胶：极轻、透明且隔热的材料，受压后会塌缩为石英。
notes: Original electronic-material implementation.
production: Place directly or combine quartz and water beside a warm catalyst.
uses: Lightweight insulation, transparency and pressure-collapse experiments.
hazards: Pressure destroys the porous structure and changes it into quartz.
controls: Keep pressure low and isolate the material from crushing loads.
cleanup: Recover quartz after collapse or reuse intact aerogel.

english_description: Carbon-Fiber Composite: Strong conductive composite made from carbon nanotube material and cured epoxy; excessive heat decomposes it.
chinese_description: 碳纤维复合材料：由碳纳米材料和固化环氧制成的高强导电复合体，过热时会分解。
notes: Original electronic-material implementation.
production: Place directly or combine carbon nanotube material with cured epoxy beside a warm catalyst.
uses: Strong lightweight structures and conductive-composite experiments.
hazards: Excessive heat decomposes the binder and releases smoke.
controls: Remove heat and ignition sources, then ventilate smoke.
cleanup: Cool intact composite or clear smoke after decomposition.

english_description: Lithium Cobalt Oxide: Charged cathode material that transfers charge through solid electrolyte; overheating releases heat and oxygen-rich flame.
chinese_description: 钴酸锂：带电正极材料，可通过固态电解质传递电荷；过热时会释热并产生富氧火焰。
notes: Original electronic-material implementation.
production: Place directly or combine lithium, cobalt and oxygen beside a hot catalyst.
uses: Battery cathodes, charge transfer and thermal-runaway experiments.
hazards: Overheating charged material releases heat and oxygen-rich flame.
controls: Disconnect conductors, remove heat and separate the cathode from fuel.
cleanup: Cool discharged material and clear fire before reuse.

english_description: Graphite Anode: Conductive carbon electrode that stores battery charge and also serves as feedstock for graphene.
chinese_description: 石墨负极：可储存电荷的导电碳电极，也是制备石墨烯的原料。
notes: Original electronic-material implementation.
production: Place directly or graphitise coal beside a very hot catalyst.
uses: Battery anodes, charge storage and graphene feedstock experiments.
hazards: High-temperature production and charged circuits can heat nearby material.
controls: Remove current and heat, then separate it from the cathode.
cleanup: Discharge through solid electrolyte or reuse as graphene feedstock.

english_description: Solid Electrolyte: Stable insulating ceramic that transfers charge between an adjacent cathode and graphite anode.
chinese_description: 固态电解质：稳定的绝缘陶瓷，可在相邻正极和石墨负极之间传递电荷。
notes: Original electronic-material implementation.
production: Place directly or combine lithium, lanthanum, zirconium and oxygen beside a hot catalyst.
uses: Solid-state batteries, insulation and controlled charge-transfer experiments.
hazards: Hot cathodes can still trigger nearby battery thermal runaway.
controls: Separate cathode and anode, then remove current and heat.
cleanup: Cool the ceramic and reuse it between discharged electrodes.

english_description: Indium Tin Oxide: Transparent conductive oxide for electrically active windows and optical experiments.
chinese_description: 氧化铟锡：透明导电氧化物，可用于通电窗体和光学实验。
notes: Original electronic-material implementation.
production: Place directly or combine indium, tin and oxygen beside a hot catalyst.
uses: Transparent electrodes, powered windows and optical-conductor experiments.
hazards: Hot synthesis and electrical current can heat nearby transparent structures.
controls: Remove current and heat, then isolate molten feedstock.
cleanup: Cool and reuse intact transparent conductor.

english_description: Phase-Change Material: Chalcogenide memory material that stops conducting in its hot amorphous state and recovers after annealing.
chinese_description: 相变存储材料：硫属化物存储材料，受热转为非晶态后停止导电，退火后可恢复。
notes: Original electronic-material implementation.
production: Place directly or combine germanium, antimony and tellurium beside a hot catalyst.
uses: Thermal memory, reversible conduction and phase-change experiments.
hazards: Rapid heating changes the stored state and may affect nearby circuits.
controls: Remove current, control temperature and isolate adjacent conductors.
cleanup: Anneal the material to restore conduction or cool it in the chosen state.

english_description: Electrochromic Material: Transparent oxide that switches between clear and dark states when pulsed with electricity.
chinese_description: 电致变色材料：透明氧化物，接收电脉冲时会在透明和深色状态之间切换。
notes: Original electronic-material implementation.
production: Place directly or combine tungsten, oxygen and quartz beside a hot catalyst.
uses: Switchable windows, optical indicators and pulse-state experiments.
hazards: Repeated pulses add heat to nearby powered structures.
controls: Disconnect current and allow the material to cool.
cleanup: Pulse once more for the alternate state or reuse it as-is.

english_description: Photoresist: Photosensitive coating whose exposed regions can be removed with acetone.
chinese_description: 光刻胶：光敏涂层，吸收足够光子后，曝光区域可被丙酮移除。
notes: Original electronic-material implementation.
production: Place directly or combine uncured epoxy resin and polystyrene beside a warm catalyst.
uses: Optical patterning, exposure and solvent-development experiments.
hazards: Acetone removes exposed coating and excessive heat produces smoke.
controls: Remove light, solvent and heat after the desired pattern forms.
cleanup: Wash away exposed regions or preserve unexposed coating.

english_description: Dielectric Ceramic: Insulating ceramic that stores up to eight charge units and then discharges into an adjacent conductor.
chinese_description: 介电陶瓷：绝缘陶瓷，最多可储存八个电荷单位，随后向邻近导体放电。
notes: Original electronic-material implementation.
production: Place directly or combine barium and titanium dioxide beside a hot catalyst.
uses: Charge storage, delayed discharge and high-dielectric insulation experiments.
hazards: Stored charge can discharge unexpectedly into an adjacent conductor.
controls: Disconnect conductors and wait for stored charge to dissipate.
cleanup: Discharge safely through a conductor, then cool and reuse the ceramic.

english_description: Soil: Porous powder that stores nearby fresh water, releases it as vapour when heated, and combines humus with nutrients into more soil.
chinese_description: 土壤：多孔粉末，可储存邻近清水，受热时以水蒸气释放，并能把腐殖质和营养盐转为更多土壤。
notes: Concept-level rewrite after reviewing Ultimata and nucular soil designs.
production: Direct placement or heated sludge drying.
uses: Water buffering soil formation and toxin adsorption.
hazards: Stored polluted liquid and hot vapour require containment.
controls: Remove water heat toxin humus and nutrients to stop reactions.
cleanup: Dry or reuse soil and route adsorbed toxin into sludge.

english_description: Wastewater: Conductive polluted water that biofilm can filter into distilled water; nutrients and algae can instead turn it into an algal bloom.
chinese_description: 污水：可导电的污染水，生物膜可将其过滤为蒸馏水；若同时存在营养盐和藻类，则会形成藻华。
notes: Original bounded wastewater and eutrophication implementation.
production: Direct placement or contamination and washing reactions.
uses: Wastewater treatment eutrophication and pollution transport.
hazards: Conductive polluted water can spread contamination into treatment chains.
controls: Separate nutrients algae and biofilm according to the intended experiment.
cleanup: Filter through biofilm then manage the resulting sludge.

english_description: Pesticide: Broad biological treatment that removes pathogens, mould, algae, or blooms but leaves toxic residue.
chinese_description: 农药：广谱生物处理液，可清除病原体、霉菌、藻类或藻华，但会留下有毒残留物。
notes: Original single-target treatment with explicit toxic residue.
uses: Broad biological control and pollution tradeoff experiments.
hazards: Treatment creates toxin after one event.
controls: Keep away from non-target ecology and water.
cleanup: Adsorb toxin with wet soil or route it through wastewater treatment.

english_description: Heavy-Metal Contaminant: Dense toxic powder that pollutes nearby fresh water and can be captured into sludge by biofilm.
chinese_description: 重金属污染物：高密度有毒粉末，会污染邻近清水，也可被生物膜捕获并转入污泥。
notes: Original mixture proxy distinct from placeable pure heavy metals.
uses: Water contamination sediment transport and biofilm capture.
hazards: Dense toxic conductive powder contaminates nearby fresh water.
controls: Use sealed dry handling or surround with biofilm.
cleanup: Capture into sludge and isolate the residue.

english_description: Radioactive Contaminant: Dispersed radioactive particulate that can foul water and eventually decays into heavy-metal residue with one short photon pulse.
chinese_description: 放射性污染物：分散的放射性颗粒，可污染水体，最终衰变为重金属残留并产生一次短寿命光子脉冲。
notes: Original low-level pollution proxy distinct from reactor waste and isotopes.
uses: Finite decay water contamination and radiation-cleanup experiments.
hazards: Radiation heat photon emission and contaminated water require shielding.
controls: Keep dry and shielded until decay completes.
cleanup: Contain the heavy-metal residue and filter contaminated water.

english_description: Microplastic: Light persistent polymer fragments that biofilm can trap into sludge; strong heat produces smog.
chinese_description: 微塑料：轻质持久的聚合物碎屑，可被生物膜捕获进入污泥，强热时会产生烟霾。
notes: Original persistent particulate with bounded capture and pyrolysis.
uses: Particulate pollution filtration and thermal-decomposition experiments.
controls: Keep cool or place beside biofilm for capture.
cleanup: Capture into sludge and dry or isolate the residue.

english_description: Organic Waste: Compostable feedstock that wet mycelium converts into humus and nutrients; strong heat produces smog.
chinese_description: 有机废物：可堆肥原料，湿润菌丝会将其转为腐殖质和营养盐，强热时会产生烟霾。
notes: Original bounded compost and thermal-pollution feedstock.
uses: Composting nutrient recovery mould feedstock and smog production.
hazards: Strong heat produces toxic airborne pollution.
controls: Keep wet near mycelium for composting or isolate from heat.
cleanup: Recover humus and nutrients or scrub the resulting smog.

english_description: Algal Bloom: Nutrient-rich biomass that consumes nearby oxygen and eventually settles into sludge.
chinese_description: 藻华：富营养生物质，会消耗邻近氧气，最终沉降为污泥。
notes: Original finite-lifetime eutrophication material without particle creation.
production: Direct placement or wastewater algae and nutrient contact.
hazards: Dense blooms consume oxygen and leave sludge.
controls: Remove nutrient inputs or treat with pesticide or antimicrobial material.
cleanup: Collect and compost or dry the sludge.

english_description: Mold: Moist growth that spreads by consuming wood, cellulose, or organic waste and eventually decays into humus.
chinese_description: 霉菌：湿润环境中的生长物，可消耗木材、纤维素或有机废物扩散，老化后转为腐殖质。
notes: Original feed-limited growth with no particle creation.
production: Direct placement or feed-limited growth on wet organic matter.
hazards: Growth consumes organic feed and can spread while moisture remains.
controls: Remove water and feed or apply finite treatment materials.
cleanup: Wait for humus conversion or treat and compost residue.

english_description: Blood: Dense biological liquid that carries a limited amount of oxygen, reacts with pathogens, and coagulates into humus while still or hot.
chinese_description: 血液：高密度生物液体，可携带有限氧气、与病原体反应，并在静止或受热时凝结为腐殖质。
notes: Concept-level rewrite after reviewing Ultimata and Biological Mod blood designs.
uses: Oxygen transport pathogen exposure and coagulation experiments.
hazards: Pathogens create toxin and stationary blood eventually coagulates.
controls: Keep moving and separated from pathogens or heat.
cleanup: Allow safe coagulation into humus and treat toxin residue.

english_description: Toxin: Harmful liquid that damages nearby algae, mycelium, mould, or blooms, leaving wastewater.
chinese_description: 毒素：有害液体，会损伤邻近藻类、菌丝、霉菌或藻华，并留下污水。
notes: Original single-event toxic liquid with explicit cleanup path.
production: Direct placement pesticide residue or pathogen-exposed blood.
uses: Biological damage adsorption and wastewater-treatment experiments.
hazards: Toxic liquid damages multiple ecological materials.
controls: Keep separated from biological materials and fresh water.
cleanup: Adsorb with wet soil then route sludge and wastewater for treatment.

english_description: Antimicrobial Material: Durable solid surface that removes nearby pathogens, mould, or blooms and becomes dust when exhausted.
chinese_description: 抗菌材料：耐用的固体表面，可清除邻近病原体、霉菌或藻华，失效后转为尘埃。
notes: Original finite-charge treatment surface distinct from consumable disinfectant.
uses: Bounded surface disinfection and treatment-capacity experiments.
hazards: Exhausted surfaces become inert dust and bloom treatment leaves sludge.
controls: Track the remaining charge state and isolate non-target biology.
cleanup: Collect dust and compost biological residue.

english_description: Sludge: Dense treatment residue that mycelium can compost into humus or heat can dry into soil while releasing water vapour.
chinese_description: 污泥：高密度处理残留，可由菌丝堆肥为腐殖质，也可受热干燥为土壤并释放水蒸气。
notes: Original recovery intermediate shared by pollution paths.
production: Direct placement filtration neutralisation or biological collapse.
uses: Residue settling composting and soil recovery.
hazards: Heating releases water vapour and contaminated sludge should be contained.
controls: Compost at mild temperature or dry in a controlled area.
cleanup: Reuse recovered soil and humus while venting clean vapour.

english_description: Smog: Toxic airborne pollution that combines with water vapour and condenses into acid rain.
chinese_description: 烟霾：有毒空气污染物，与水蒸气结合后会凝结为酸雨。
notes: Original toxic gas using the official-style shared gas renderer.
production: Direct placement or strong heating of microplastic and organic waste.
uses: Air-pollution transport condensation and acid-rain experiments.
hazards: Toxic gas spreads and water vapour produces corrosive rain.
controls: Vent or isolate from water vapour.
cleanup: Condense deliberately then neutralise acid rain with lime.

english_description: Acid Rain: Conductive corrosive water that damages soil and common metal, while calcium hydroxide neutralises it into distilled water and sludge.
chinese_description: 酸雨：可导电的腐蚀性水，会破坏土壤和常见金属；氢氧化钙可将其转为蒸馏水和污泥。
notes: Original bounded environmental acid distinct from concentrated chemistry acids.
production: Direct placement or smog condensation with water vapour.
uses: Dilute corrosion soil damage and neutralisation experiments.
hazards: Corrosive conductive liquid damages soil and common metal.
controls: Keep away from soil and metal or surround with calcium hydroxide.
cleanup: Neutralise into distilled water and sludge.

english_description: Detergent: Surfactant liquid that mixes one oil particle and one fresh-water particle into treatable wastewater, consuming itself.
chinese_description: 洗涤剂：表面活性液体，可把一粒石油和一粒清水混合为可处理污水，同时消耗自身。
notes: Original stoichiometric oil-washing proxy without global liquid scans.
hazards: Washing converts clean water and oil into polluted wastewater.
controls: Use only beside the intended oil and water sample.
cleanup: Filter all wastewater through biofilm and manage sludge.
